# nb-studio app

## app config get

Read an app's configuration

Requires the `configure` action on the App. People only. Secret values are masked and never returned.

```bash
nb-studio app config get <app>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `app`    |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.apps/configure`.

**Request:** `GET /api/releases/apps/{appId}/config` (`releasesGetAppConfig`)

## app config set

Replace an app's configuration

Requires the `configure` action on the App. People only. Saves the running deployment’s `config.yml` and asks the runtime to reload it; a masked value keeps the stored secret, `secretChanges` set or remove secrets.

```bash
nb-studio app config set <app> --content <string>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `app`    |             |

| Flag               | Type   | Description                                                      |
| ------------------ | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--content`        | string | The configuration, as YAML. (required; or --content-file <path>) |
| `--secret-changes` | json   |                                                                  |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.apps/configure`.

**Request:** `PUT /api/releases/apps/{appId}/config` (`releasesReplaceAppConfig`)

## app create

Create an app

Requires the `create` action on every App.

```bash
nb-studio app create <app> --name <string> --env <string>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `app`    |             |

| Flag                    | Type              | Description                                          |
| ----------------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `--name`                | string            | (required)                                           |
| `--env`                 | string            | (required)                                           |
| `--description`         | string            |                                                      |
| `--label`               | json              | A label (key=value); repeat for more.                |
| `--preview-of`          | string            | Makes it a preview App of that App, removed with it. |
| `--activation`          | eager \| onDemand |                                                      |
| `--idle-stop-minutes`   | number            |                                                      |
| `--dormant-after-hours` | number            |                                                      |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.apps/create`.

**Request:** `POST /api/releases/apps` (`releasesCreateApp`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio app create my-app --name "My App" --env staging
```

## app delete

Delete an app

Requires the `delete` action on the App. People only. Removes the App with its releases and data; `confirm` must repeat the App ID.

```bash
nb-studio app delete <app>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `app`    |             |

| Flag        | Type    | Description                                             |
| ----------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--confirm` | string  | The App ID again.                                       |
| `--yes`     | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Delete the App with its data?” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.apps/delete`.

**Request:** `DELETE /api/releases/apps/{appId}` (`releasesDeleteApp`)

## app deploy

Deploy a release

Requires the `deploy` action on the App. A protected environment is deployed only through a deployment request an approver approves (`POST /apps/{appId}/deploymentRequests`), so deploying there directly is refused. The `Idempotency-Key` header, or `idempotencyKey`, answers a repeated request with its first deployment.

```bash
nb-studio app deploy <app> --release <string>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `app`    |             |

| Flag        | Type    | Description                                                              |
| ----------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--wait`    | boolean | Wait up to 100 seconds for the deployment to finish, and answer it then. |
| `--release` | string  | (required)                                                               |
| `--config`  | json    |                                                                          |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `rel.apps/deploy`.

**Request:** `POST /api/releases/apps/{appId}/deploy` (`releasesDeployApp`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio app deploy my-app --release <release> --wait true
```

## app ensure

Make sure of an App in an environment

Idempotent: makes the App in the environment when it is missing, and does nothing when it runs there; one running in another environment is refused (`APP_IN_OTHER_ENVIRONMENT`). Making it takes a credential that may create Apps, or the repository’s CI key, for which Studio makes it as whoever set the CI up; an existing App takes the `upload` action on it, or the repository’s CI key for an App of the repository. An App made here whose first deployment is an open pull request’s head becomes that pull request’s preview, deleted once it is merged or closed.

```bash
nb-studio app ensure <app> --environment <string>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `app`    |             |

| Flag            | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| --------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--environment` | string | The environment the App runs in: it is made there when missing, and refused when it runs in another. (required)                                                                                        |
| `--repository`  | string | The repository the App is made for, as `owner/repo`; when none is named, the one whose CI key the credential is. A CI key may name only its own. (default from $GITHUB_REPOSITORY or $CI_PROJECT_PATH) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.apps/upload`.

**Request:** `POST /api/builds/apps/{appId}/ensure` (`buildsEnsureApp`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio app ensure my-app-pr-12 --environment preview
nb-studio app ensure my-app-staging --environment staging --repository acme/my-app
```

## app env list

List an app's variables

Requires the `view` action on the App. The variables its release declares and those set on it or its environment, with where each value comes from (`source`) and whether a required one is `missing`. A secret’s value is never returned.

```bash
nb-studio app env list <app>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `app`    |             |

| Flag        | Type   | Description                                                                               |
| ----------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--release` | string | Read the variables against this release; the running one (else the newest) when left out. |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `name`, `source`, `value`, `required`, `missing`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `rel.apps/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/releases/apps/{appId}/variables` (`releasesListAppVariables`)

## app env set

Set an app's variable

Requires the `configure` action on the App. People only. It reaches the App with its next deployment. A name the runtime sets itself is refused (`VARIABLE_RESERVED`).

```bash
nb-studio app env set <app> <name> <value>
```

| Argument | Description                |
| -------- | -------------------------- |
| `app`    |                            |
| `name`   |                            |
| `value`  | The value; at most 64 KiB. |

| Flag       | Type    | Description                                                                                       |
| ---------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--secret` | boolean | Never shown again once set. Taken from the release’s manifest, else from the name, when left out. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.apps/configure`.

**Request:** `PUT /api/releases/apps/{appId}/variables/{name}` (`releasesSetAppVariable`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio app env set crm-staging SMTP_HOST smtp.example.com
nb-studio app env set crm-staging SMTP_PASSWORD --from-env
```

## app env unset

Remove an app's variable

Requires the `configure` action on the App. People only. Removes the App’s value; its environment’s applies again.

```bash
nb-studio app env unset <app> <name>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `app`    |             |
| `name`   |             |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.apps/configure`.

**Request:** `DELETE /api/releases/apps/{appId}/variables/{name}` (`releasesDeleteAppVariable`)

## app list

List apps

Requires the `view` action; lists the Apps it reaches. `q` searches, `label=key=value` (repeatable) filters by label.

```bash
nb-studio app list
```

| Flag       | Type    | Description                           |
| ---------- | ------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `--page`   | integer | (default 1)                           |
| `--limit`  | integer | (default 20)                          |
| `--search` | string  |                                       |
| `--env`    | string  |                                       |
| `--label`  | json    | A label (key=value); repeat for more. |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `app.id`, `app.name`, `environment.name`, `runtime.state`, `currentVersion`, `url`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `rel.apps/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/releases/apps` (`releasesListApps`)

## app logs

Read an app's runtime logs

Requires the `read-logs` action on the App. Not a stream: each read returns one bounded chunk as JSON. Read on with `pageToken` set to the previous `meta.nextPageToken`; reading the same token later returns what was appended since, so a client tails a log by polling. `meta.enabled` is false when the driver keeps no logs.

```bash
nb-studio app logs <app>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `app`    |             |

| Flag           | Type                                             | Description |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ----------- |
| `--page-token` | string                                           |             |
| `--level`      | trace \| debug \| info \| warn \| error \| fatal |             |
| `--source`     | string                                           |             |
| `--search`     | string                                           |             |
| `--since`      | string                                           |             |
| `--until`      | string                                           |             |
| `--from-start` | boolean                                          |             |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `time`, `level`, `msg`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `rel.apps/read-logs`.

**Request:** `GET /api/releases/apps/{appId}/logs` (`releasesReadAppLogs`)

## app rollback

Roll an app back

Requires the `deploy` action on the App. Deploys again the release of an earlier successful deployment; on a protected environment it is requested instead (`rollbackToDeploymentId`).

```bash
nb-studio app rollback <app> --deployment <string>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `app`    |             |

| Flag           | Type   | Description |
| -------------- | ------ | ----------- |
| `--deployment` | string | (required)  |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `rel.apps/deploy`.

**Request:** `POST /api/releases/apps/{appId}/rollback` (`releasesRollbackApp`)
